items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: I cannot find no original that Mongo ever did. I don't think -- his mind don't move that way. I don't think he got the capacity. I hate to say this, but let's put everything in a respectable place. That's my own opinion.

ctx.x: And the Cuban men tried to be jazz. I darn well don't appreciate that.
Okay. What about, now, a man who did a lot of mixing in the '60s, musical mixing, was Mongo Santamaria. Mongo's band here in the '60s.

Let me tell you one thing. I cannot find no original that Mongo ever did. I don't think -- his mind don't move that way. I don't think he got the capacity. I hate to say this, but let's put everything in a respectable place. That's my own opinion.
